notes.title: Version 28.5: Get ready to jump into Early Access!
notes.notes:
[h2]Exciting News, Everyone![/h2]
This is our final patch before we make the big leap to Early Access tomorrow. We're thrilled about this milestone and hope you are too. Here’s what you can expect in this last update before the big day:

[h3]"Chain" missions[/h3]
Embark on thrilling multistage missions to earn more goldies and unlock new rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/bc576ec2f5b863f158c615e99f69e68764764de4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Voiceover for tutorial[/h3]
We've introduced a voiceover in the tutorial! It's not fully polished yet, but it’s there to enhance the experience for new players. Expect further improvements in upcoming patches.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/6e9b25ad5434b016370556a57373749b948a69a2.png[/img]

[h3]New artwork[/h3]
Check out the fresh artwork for these cards: Ocean D. Finley, Archimimus, Alien Abduction, Firebrand Lassie, Clumsy Cactus, and Jurassic Canon Fodder. Thanks to our awesome artists for bringing these characters to life with their illustrations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/26949dee3328cba5dd8c506dcdb1cb720aea6369.png[/img]

[h3]New Movie Sets: [/h3]
Explore genre-themed movie sets now available in the store:
[list]
[*] Comedy: Dive into hilarious mix-ups at a fun fair.
[*] Mystery: Solve a bank robbery gone wrong with secret shadows lurking.
[*] Drama: Ramp up the telenovela tension in a wealthy family's estate.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3de5ddb07dba0cdd90c667cbb4b86bf0f3a11c7a.png[/img]

[h3]New Card Backs: [/h3]
We've added a variety of new card backs and other exciting goodies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/2faa59c9bdbaa5f0b6e7ce3aeb0104cf5d028128.png[/img]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added non-animated version of Sly, adjusted cost of animated Sly to be in line with other animated directors.
[*] CyboBoy and Bartender Hydra would not freeze from their planned attack, if they have been already frozen (thanks, @Dunkoro).
[*] After mass effects characters won't get stuck under each other and move to proper position on the set right away (thanks, @kramushka and friends).
[*] When you steal narrative points from opponent, your Sleight of hand trickster won't return back to your hand (thanks, @Majstor).
[*] If character under Bloodbeards effect attacks and dies during an attack, it won't steal the narrative points.
[*] Fixed Spikes visuals alignment.
[*] Character with lethal has to deal attack damage for it to activate, Spikes and Backfire is not considered attack damage (thanks, @Dunkoro)
[*] Making copy of the deck won't overwrite already exist copy.
[*] When collecting large number of bounty points after AoE, they are properly spread between Lead and the free narrative points (thanks, @NatriOn).
[/list]

[h3]Looking Ahead:[/h3]
This release sets the stage for our early access launch tomorrow. Get ready, spread the word, and dive into the world of ScreenPlay, where creativity meets cinema. Calling all visionary directors to join us!

notes.title: ScreenPlay Transition to Demo Soon, Playtest to be Discontinued
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639189/7dac51bfb0859820a99405ff0fc57ade1d6938d0.png[/img]

As we draw closer to the early access release of ScreenPlay, we're thrilled about reaching this significant milestone and hope you share our excitement! In preparation, we are transitioning from the Steam 'Playtest' to a Demo version. This change aims to increase visibility and attract more players as we enter this crucial phase. Rest assured, all your collections will be smoothly transferred to the demo version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639189/eaa1eb9abdfbd67ed7b6467b2943ce11d3109dab.png[/img]

Please note that the Playtest version will be discontinued on May 5, 2024, at 4:00 PM CEST. We encourage you to switch to the demo version as soon as possible, which will require no additional downloads.

Thank you for your continued support. We look forward to seeing you on set!

notes.title: Lights, Camera, Action! ScreenPlay CCG Early Access Countdown Begins!
notes.notes:
[h1]Get Ready to Roll the Film Reels - ScreenPlay CCG's Early Access is Almost Here![/h1]

Hello, everyone! We're thrilled to share that ScreenPlay CCG is just 10 days away from its Early Access release on Steam. The anticipation is palpable and we're excited to see the community's reaction to all the new features!

[h2]🎮 Seamless Transition[/h2]
For those of you who have been enjoying the demo or participating in our playtests, we've got some fantastic news. All your progress is tied to your Steam account, meaning everything you've achieved will carry over to the Early Access version seamlessly. Keep building your collection without missing a beat!

[h2]🎥 New Trailer Alert![/h2]
[previewyoutube=HBe_GIkjqiE;full][/previewyoutube]
We've just dropped a fresh trailer filled with all the latest additions to the game, crafted with a fun nod to those classic 1990s movie trailers. Check it out here and let us know what you think. Your likes and comments not only support us but also help more folks discover the game through the YouTube algorithm.

[h2]📢 Calling All Content Creators![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/2f4ace13604ec320e0f94d8e655c85574e0e5ce9.png[/img]
Are you passionate about Screenplay CCG and love creating content? We'd love to connect with you! Join our special Directors Guild program designed to support both you and your audience. It’s a fantastic way to engage with the game and get more involved in our community of virtual movie-makers.

[h2]🌐 We Speak Your Language[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/8201a53ae05e651e01ab894e4426051eea38849e.png[/img]
Localization is coming! We're working on adding multiple language supports around the Early Access launch. If there’s a specific language you’re hoping for, don't hesitate to drop a suggestion in the comments. Your feedback is invaluable.

[h2]🏆 Join Our Discord for Weekly Tournaments[/h2]
Don’t miss out on the action in our Discord community where you can participate in weekly tournaments and win awesome rewards. It's a great place to meet other players and test your directorial skills in friendly competition.

As a small indie team, every bit of support from you helps us a great deal. We don't have a massive budget, but what we do have is a passionate team dedicated to creating an engaging CCG experience. Spread the word, invite friends who love card games, blog about your experiences, and tell your favorite streamer about what they’re missing!

[h2]🌟 Add Screenplay CCG to Your Wishlist[/h2]
If you haven't already, please consider adding Screenplay CCG to your wishlist to stay updated on our latest developments.

Thank you all for your tremendous support. We can’t wait to see you in-game and together, let’s make some incredible movies!

🎬 Let's make fun movies!

notes.title: ScreenPlay Update 28.4
notes.notes:
Hey Directors! We've been hard at work adding new enhancements, content, and bug fixes. There's plenty more on the way as we gear up for our Early Access launch in May 2024. Help us spread the word and invite more players to join in on the fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3938a08893b163a81d4c56f9faaa7ab02cbf6420.png[/img]

[h2]Enhancements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduced a new UI for cards in zones such as the opponent's hand and Extras, designed for easier navigation, viewing, and selection of cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3ba024414ba1f662f77d334f81605f21b6e44481.gif[/img]
[*] Enhanced card pack opening animations now include an exciting reveal of each card, along with the ability to preview a large visual of the card once the pack is opened.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/5ec92b9262524e4bf190f5a90e2422c2c064dbe5.gif[/img]
[*] Removed redundant FX type filters from the Collection.
[*] Introduced the "Queenpin max out" animation – watch Queenpin in action!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/d715ba47a5a12da5a95366c63ff67ce89a38a9aa.png[/img]
[*] Enhanced the flow of gameplay animations by tightening the logic between sequences and shortening select animations for a faster, smoother experience.
[*] Added functionality to scroll through the collection using the mouse wheel.
[*] New Card Backs and Movie Sets available in the Store.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes: [/h2]
[list]
 [*] Corrected an issue in the tutorial where players were prompted to dodge before being shown how.
[*] Added missing spikes VFX.
[*] Fixed a bug where Totem Boy's aura was reapplying every time a new character came on set. (Thanks, @yarractheeln)
[*] Ensured performance animations will not play if a character in the Extras or in the hand. (Thanks, @jetmanskye)
[*] Addressed an issue with extra characters performing due to Qaal; they will no longer perform if Qaal was removed from the set.
[*] The Undo button will not disappear correctly if you use Qaal's performance UI first. (Thanks, @toniemacaronie16 and @tougarashi3357)
[*] Resolved an issue where characters with the pack hunt keyword would perform an empty attack instead of dodging. (Thanks, @dunkoro)
[*] Fixed "Tag[*]in!" to disallow another character from the hand to play if the selected character is not present on set when "Tag[*]in!" is used.
[*] Fixed several issues with narrative sound, including potential duplication and volume control problems. (Thanks, @yarractheeln)
[*] Addressed text cut[*]off issues in the Collection search bar.
[*] Fixed misalignment issues in Illuminati Lizard and Roast Comic Frog max out animations. (Thanks, @n4trion)
[*] Corrected the "Performances Interrupted" mission to work correctly with different sources of interruption. (Thanks, @toaster404. )
[*] Resolved the Laugh Bot crash issue. (Thanks, @dunkoro)
[*] Fixed various other minor bugs and crashes.
[/list]

Additional Note: [i]The star of the 2001 movie Exit Wounds, Steven Seagal, a noted aficionado of carrot cake, had absolutely nothing to do with this update. Any rumors of his involvement are entirely unfounded and should be dismissed.[/i]

notes.title: ScreenPlay Build 28: A Major Leap Forward
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/36d242582aee29bd6019eaa94b6bcd779c1dcec2.png[/img]

The most anticipated update for our game, Build 28, is here and it's a big one! Yes, we've even got memes about how long it's taken us to get here floating around our Discord. Here are few of our favorite Build 28 memes from our community:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/598d9873d2ed1367a5fe1b42ec0493177607d070.png[/img]

Writing this post feels huge because we've packed so much into Build 28 and we want to share every bit of it with you.

Let's dive in:

We've introduced a whole new in-game economy. Yes, directors, you read that right. Now you can manage card packs, craft cards, and make purchases from the in-game store using in-game currency. For now, real money transactions are off the table. We want you to focus on playing, having fun, and collecting awesome stuff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/d74d4d3fb9e54ca245912eff3b37e55a2a00e635.png[/img]

Card packs are here! What's a digital collectible card game without the thrill of opening card packs? You can purchase card packs by gaining soft or hard currency on completely daily missions.

[previewyoutube=59ZJvfwAhjI;full][/previewyoutube]

Crafting cards is now a thing. Cannot wait to get your favourite card? Just craft them directly using in-game hard currency.

[previewyoutube=PRKR8Y-4xlg;full][/previewyoutube]

Player now have Ranks, achieving by winning competitive PvP matches. In the next versions Ranks system will became deeper and yield more rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3fcc93b575a9a0405c51446fb803fc220913a4d1.png[/img]

We're introducing two in-game currencies: Tickets and Goldies. Players can get these in-game currencies as rewards for PvP matches and completing daily missions. Tickets allows you to buy card packs and Goldies is for buying cosmetics (such as unique deck covers, directors, movie sets, etc.), crafting cards and more. Remember, no real money involved yet. Just play, enjoy, and collect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/eb37e695116bbe80c601ab7ffcd122de9a51bdba.png[/img]

Customization options have exploded:

 Choose from a variety of director avatars, including animated versions for that extra flair.

[previewyoutube=FDQ7sdaJzuQ;full][/previewyoutube]

 Movie sets let you express your directing style. Whether you're into horror, drama, or any other genre, we've got you covered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/67e0a65d8a7ddae3e8a047602c12b520e8b9bce0.png[/img]

Get unique, genre or movie-related card backs and deck covers to stand out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/e277c491b29a680d3f753b4ff070ec427554dd4b.png[/img]

But what about the cards themselves? We've added over a hundred new cards, bringing our total to a hefty collection. With 22 lead characters now available, there's plenty to explore.

[previewyoutube=YxPZqQk4IVY;full][/previewyoutube]

New to ScreenPlay? All players will receive a starter set of cards, new Leads and several pre-constructed decks. By acquiring new cards you'll be able to expand the pre-constructed decks and build your own. The starter set leads help you get comfortable before moving on to more complex lead characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3f871d1d31e21d9bae203597098571f06c58fa1a.png[/img]

Another notable addition, we have also added a system to easily export your decklists and import decklists from online.

We've revamped the tutorial to make learning ScreenPlay easier and more fun. It's still a work in progress, with voiceovers and some polish to come, but it's a huge step up from our previous tutorial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/cb7d318b4d6c6107dee0940a28e3e0f5c0da30bf.png[/img]

And there's more: cool new VFX for cards, updated card arts, new animations for high-value attacks, and unique entrance and max-out animations for lead characters.

[previewyoutube=PzSXjseXRxg;full][/previewyoutube]

For our Discord community and tournament participants, expect unique codes for rewards. And stay tuned for more community-driven tournaments. If you're not on our Discord yet, now's the time to join and claim your rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/603ea5e0d079d16abee4d220d6d472214311e8ff.gif[/img]

Looking ahead, we're focused on speeding up the game, adding new content (card arts, VFX, SFX, and more), introducing a payment option for those who wish to support us, improving the matchmaking system, and adding PvE content.

Special thanks to our community members for reporting issues in the build, providing feedback and spreading the word to the world on your passion for ScreenPlay -- ThrillerNate, yarractheeln, MageArmour, Tougarashi, Dunkoro, Kram, Vomaa, DavidDistributed, Toaster404, Ienalaurence, JetmanSkye, Ammit, melfice, NatriOn, pixelet, Knusperpikachu, Kuchenlüge, pyrovoice, PeaceRibbon, Ettrian, Lavexis, Chappy, lyn, Canc, 209209, OldChap. (PS: If we forgot any name, let us know and will add them.)

Your support means the world to us. We're a small team, always open to feedback, ideas, and suggestions. Help us shape this game into something fun for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/9f7d017d3d380a2dfe09dc5bf4943bb9ce079354.png[/img]

[b]Lastly, with this update, we have to wipe your profiles. This is necessary given in previous version you had all cards already and it was designed for playtest experience. However, with the economy, players have to acquire cards, and your old decks would be invalid, so the best solution was to wipe the profiles. You start from a new player's POV. However, any rewards and cards you obtain from Build 28 will remain with you even on EA. This would be extremely rare for us to do any more profile wiping again. Thank you for your understanding.[/b]

Best,
The ScreenPlay Team

notes.title: Version 27.7 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes and improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the game's full-screen mode to be borderless.
[*] Fixed a bug where Jaw-Z broke the rules of narrative collecting, reported by member of our community server [b]toaster404[/b].
[*] Fixed the problem of interaction between character abilities and stolen narrative, reported by member of our community server [b]Xekon#8266[/b].
[*] Fixed few crashed related to the user interface.
[*] Corrected the description of Pro-Profit Centurion and his legionnaires, thanks to our community server member [b]yarractheeln[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/faa64f2af278329259e6122737cfe61c3f2f4316.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Addressing a Notorious Crash[/h1]
The persistent [i]"Unable to get variable res from object XXXX"[/i] error has been a major point of discussion. Our gratitude goes out to [b]toaster404 [/b]and [b]Kram[/b] for their detailed reports. 

This issue was traced back to the game engine. We have [url=https://github.com/YoYoGames/GameMaker-Bugs/issues/3929]reported this to the engine developers[/url] and they've acknowledged it as a bug.

Currently, we've implemented a temporary fix. A complete resolution will follow with an upcoming engine update. A big thank you to our community for helping us identify these issues and for your continued patience.

notes.title: Happy New Year! Update 27.6 Released
notes.notes:
Season's Greetings, movie directors! Our latest update brings you a sleigh-load of improvements.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

[b]Say goodbye to the freezing issue in the tutorial, and thanks for flagging it![/b]

Plus, we've ironed out several gameplay bugs, particularly those tricky corner cases.

[h1]Cards rebalancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Roast Comic Frog lead now gains 2 Narrative Points at the start of a scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3ec317ab2dda9d652e323195df37524c7156ad6c.jpg[/img]

[*] Jaw-Z lead now gains 2 Narrative Points for a successful performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/c716b6797f4615584f4adb35649787ac1f8d68ee.jpg[/img]

[*] Pro-Profit Centurion character now enters on the 4th frame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/87176beec9893b3bc13bc5f57c8ae09a5abc920d.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Matchmaking tuning[/h1]
To enhance your gaming experience, our matchmaking system initially tries to find you a fellow player for a few minutes. During this wait, you'll see a pop-up offering two choices: either jump into a game with a bot or keep waiting for a real player. You also have the option to team up with a friend. If a player match isn't found after a certain period, the system might pair you with a bot for that round, but will try for a real player in the next. To make the most of your experience, we encourage you to invite friends to join the game. Playing with friends not only makes the game more enjoyable but also helps build our community. Plus, check out our Discord for PvP hours to play when our player base is most active.

[h1]Visuals[/h1]
We've added some visual flair to the game. Enjoy the new flat turtle animation, plus fireworks for the victory screen!
[previewyoutube=3e7qSv02Nq4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Deckbuilding[/h1]
We're gradually introducing more intricate rules:

This update adds deckbuilding guidelines:
[list]
[*] Minimum 40 cards in a deck. maximum of 60.
[*] Include 2 or 3 lead cards.
[*] Leads' genres dictate other card genres.
[*] Amount of copies is determined by each card's rarity (number of dots in bottom left corner).
[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/d9caecb9544df475659ec07c11771e55faee220d.jpg[/img][/center]
[center][i]Up to three copies for Bartender Hydra, four for Ben Bones' Edits.[/i][/center]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/092ddc489eaddac8e293a46a83b2a612e5a7cb6f.jpg[/img]
Heads up: Your deck might need some tweaking to comply with the new rules. We've updated our preconstructed decks accordingly. Happy building!
